rule: Valid structured output; required fields present; option IDs unique.
Maps to exactly one primary certification objective and does not violate exclusions.json's excludedTopics or scopeGuardrail.
Sufficient information is present; no dependence on hidden assumptions.
Reviewer independently reaches same answer(s) or item is quarantined.
Plausible but demonstrably inferior/incorrect; no joke or giveaway options.
Exactly one best answer for single-choice; explicit count/selection rule for multiple response.
No exact duplicate; near-duplicate threshold configurable.
No claim that generated content is an official or leaked exam item.
